summary: XPRIZE Adaptive Plants has no machine-readable opportunity feed and no open applicant call. The competition page is a fundraising appeal (Become a sponsor, Future/FUNDRAISING status on the listing), with no deadline, registration window or purse stated. Only the html adapter can monitor it for status change, so it stores no opportunity rows.
